topic: Review of new analytics report draft
summary_markdown:
A preliminary version of a performance report was shared for review. The new "Compare Report" button is currently visible only on the Proantaž view. This report captures all parameters except time granularity; it reports data for the selected period rather than requiring selection of a previous period, which is automatically calculated.

The recipient needs to check if the displayed data and format are expected, correct any terminology, and verify the figures in Excel.
